The record still indicates a below-target result in a named regulated-customer or contractual segment, which is a materiality indicator under the policy text.

final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor did not supply new admissible evidence; the response narrows and clarifies the claim using the same underlying record. That clarification is useful, but it does not resolve the core compliance predicate. The Actor now concedes that the present record does not support clean compliant certification, that the named segment miss is a materiality indicator, that the legal ticket is still open, and that there is no evidence of completed disclosure or approved risk acceptance before launch. Those concessions align with the initial audit concern rather than curing it. A caveated certification packet may be a more accurate description of the operational posture, but it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats here because the caveat is itself an unresolved pre-launch policy condition, not merely a residual risk to document. On the admissible record available to this role, the claim remains suspicious rather than compliant.
